Sign an AWS S3 href using a presigned URL.

Source: R/signers.R
sign_aws_s3.Rd

Generates a short-lived presigned GET URL for an S3 object using paws.storage. Authentication follows the standard AWS credential chain: environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN), ~/.aws/credentials, or an IAM instance profile (EC2, ECS, Lambda). Suitable for passing directly as the sign_fn argument of stac_api_router().

Usage

sign_aws_s3(
  href,
  expiry_seconds = 3600L,
  region = Sys.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION", unset = "us-east-1")
)

Arguments

href

Unsigned S3 URL. Accepts s3://bucket/key, virtual-hosted style (https://bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com/key), and path style (https://s3.region.amazonaws.com/bucket/key).

expiry_seconds

Lifetime of the presigned URL in seconds (default 3600).

region

AWS region. Defaults to the AWS_DEFAULT_REGION environment variable, falling back to "us-east-1".

Value

A presigned URL string.
